import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import glob
import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def parse_feed(filepath):
    try:
        tree = ET.parse(filepath)
        root = tree.getroot()
        items = []
        for item in root.findall('.//item'):
            title = item.find('title')
            link = item.find('link')
            pub_date = item.find('pubDate')
            desc = item.find('description')
            
            title_text = title.text.strip() if title is not None and title.text else ''
            link_text = link.text.strip() if link is not None and link.text else ''
            pub_date_text = pub_date.text.strip() if pub_date is not None and pub_date.text else ''
            desc_text = desc.text.strip() if desc is not None and desc.text else ''
            
            items.append({
                'feed': os.path.basename(filepath),
                'title': title_text,
                'link': link_text,
                'pubDate': pub_date_text,
                'desc': desc_text
            })
        return items
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error parsing {filepath}: {e}')
        return []

all_items = []
for f in glob.glob('/tmp/scout_feeds/*.xml'):
    all_items.extend(parse_feed(f))

# Print first 20 items to inspect
for i, item in enumerate(all_items[:30]):
    print(f\"{i}. [{item['feed']}] {item['title']} - {item['link']} ({item['pubDate']})\")
"

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import glob
import os

import email.utils

def parse_feed(filepath):
    try:
        # Avoid parse failures for invalid characters if possible
        with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
            content = f.read()
        root = ET.fromstring(content)
        items = []
        for item in root.findall('.//item'):
            title = item.find('title')
            link = item.find('link')
            pub_date = item.find('pubDate')
            desc = item.find('description')
            
            title_text = title.text.strip() if title is not None and title.text else ''
            link_text = link.text.strip() if link is not None and link.text else ''
            pub_date_text = pub_date.text.strip() if pub_date is not None and pub_date.text else ''
            desc_text = desc.text.strip() if desc is not None and desc.text else ''
            
            items.append({
                'feed': os.path.basename(filepath),
                'title': title_text,
                'link': link_text,
                'pubDate': pub_date_text,
                'desc': desc_text
            })
        return items
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error parsing {filepath}: {e}')
        return []

all_items = []
for f in glob.glob('/tmp/scout_feeds/*.xml'):
    all_items.extend(parse_feed(f))

# Look at items from today (May 25, 2026 or last 24 hours)
